_meta.scope: Why microreactors tab (arguments): Type G checks on time-sensitive argument numbers; Type N policy items for studies, reports or analyses dated 2026-10-31 to 2026-11-10 that change the case for or against 1-20 MW reactors. Skip lists read: skip/arguments.json, skip/news.json.
angles_run: Studies: microreactor cost per kW, Nov 2026 (2 searches, nothing dated in window)
National labs: INL, DOE Liftoff update, NREL, GAIN (4 searches; Liftoff update found is dated 2024-10-01, outside window)
NEI and EPRI cost reports (2 searches, no 2026 report found)
IEA, CBO, GAO, NRC/DOE pilot oversight (3 searches, none found)
Insurer and lender reports (1 search, none dated in window; Marsh/Willis coverage is March to May 2026)
Academic cost studies, arXiv LCOE (2 searches, nothing dated in window; arXiv 2506.13361 and 2512.16032 predate it)
EIA Today in Energy SMR cost (1 search, article not located; secondary coverage dated 2026-04-30)
Argument check: liability, Price-Anderson 10 CFR 140.11 deferred premium (1 search, 2 fetches: confirmed $158,026,000)
Argument check: inherit, MISO surplus interconnection in-service time (1 search, no figure found)
absences: No major study, report or analysis dated 2026-10-31 to 2026-11-10 was found for any of: DOE Liftoff, NEI, EPRI, IEA, CBO, GAO, NREL, INL, insurers or lenders, or academic cost work. The search index returned no items dated inside the window, so zero Type N policy items were written. Re-run later in November with publisher sites (liftoff.energy.gov, nei.org, epri.com, iea.org, gao.gov, cbo.gov, inl.gov) checked directly.
The DOE Liftoff update surfaced by search (World Nuclear News, 'US DOE launches first update of Liftoff report') is dated 2024-10-01 by its page, so it is outside the window and was not used.
MISO surplus interconnection average in-service time ('about a year on average since 2024', argument 'inherit'): no published MISO figure found in search. Not checked; no verdict written.

$500,000,000 primary financial protection for a 300 MWe unit (argument 'liability'): not found in the 2023 Federal Register notice fetched, and the eCFR and NRC copies of 10 CFR 140.11 redirected and were not retrieved. Only the $158,026,000 figure was checked.
10 CFR 140.12 microreactor formula amount, $4,500,000 floor and $74,000,000 cap (argument 'liability'): not checked.
DOME 20 MWth facility cap (argument 'first-article'), ERCOT 9.9 MW and 10.1 MW process timings (argument 'thresholds'), and New York 5 MW and $750 fee (argument 'thresholds'): not checked.

checks.claim: accepts a contingent retrospective assessment of $158,026,000
checks.evidence: Federal Register notice of the 2023 inflation adjustment to the Price-Anderson financial protection regulations (88 FR 60565, 5 Sept 2023) sets the maximum total deferred premium at $158,026,000 (annual standard deferred premium $24,714,000), amending 10 CFR 140.11(a)(4). The fetched page does not state the $500,000,000 primary amount, which was not checked.

sources.label: Federal Register — Inflation Adjustments to the Price-Anderson Act Financial Protection Regulations (5 Sept 2023)
